language.label: Response Language
language.helperText: The language the agent will use to respond. If not set, it inherits from the organization's default language.

enabled.label: Agent active
enabled.helperText: Switch off to pause the agent in one step. It stops replying on every channel and new customer messages wait for your team under Needs Attention.

toast.setAsDefaultFailed: Failed to set agent as default. Please try again.
toast.enabledSuccess: Agent resumed. It replies to customers again.
toast.disabledSuccess: Agent paused. New customer messages wait in Needs Attention.
toast.deleteFailed: Failed to delete agent. Please try again.
toast.bulkDeletePartial: Successfully deleted {success} agent(s). Failed to delete {failed} agent(s).
toast.bulkDeleteFailed: Failed to delete agents. Please try again.
toast.updateFailed: Failed to update agent. Please try again.
toast.createFailed: Failed to create agent. Please try again.

sharedChannel.description: Choose which channels this agent handles. A channel can be assigned to more than one agent; then the default agent answers if it is one of them, otherwise the oldest enabled agent.
sharedChannel.note: {channel} is also assigned to {agents}. {responder} answers there: the default agent if it is one of them, otherwise the oldest.
